method: hurdle GLM, nested: C/alpha/shift on 1995–2004, refit 1947–2004, report 2005–2014
identification: No draft pick. Draft-night traits only. Age clipped to 17–25.5. Missing production is omitted, not treated as a typical college line. Career PPG/RPG/APG print only when that counting stat exists. Honors use miss_pts/miss_ast when the scoring or assist line is absent. High school box scores are skipped. High school counting stats are stored as hs_* and never scored as college points. McDonald's All-American is a binary from 1977 on; pre-1977 is missing, not a zero. College FT% is skip-missing and centered on 72%. International counting stats are kept and centered on a typical pro line (10 pts, 2 ast, 1 stl, 0.8 blk), not an NCAA line. Size: height, weight, pounds-per-inch, wingspan, ape, standing reach, size-at-position, swing. Missing length/reach/wpi do not fire. Swing is listed two-spot vs one-spot. Career PPG/RPG/APG/BPG from the same draft-night traits. No pick. College blocks are capped at 2.0 for honors (steals at 2.5). A 4-block night is not 4 All-Stars. Hall still skips stocks. Springfield is not a shot-blocking contest.

hof.from: P(HOF|1–3 AS)·P(AS) + P(HOF|4+ AS)·P(eAs in 4+ range). 1–3 All-Stars are ~3% HOF. Never-All-Star is not a Hall path.

baselines_holdout_as.name: pick (forbidden oracle)
baselines_holdout_as.note: Not in the product. Identification cost.

stocks_ablation.note: Capping college blocks at 2.0 for honors. Raw 4.4 and 5.2 look like 2.0. Holdout AUC improves vs uncapped. Zeroing stocks kills Shaq/AD and under-calls the All-Star rate.
